name: opencode-suite-install-v2
body:
`apg init` installs the opencode 2.x suite into the global opencode config directory `~/.config/opencode/`. It installs the tool plugins into `~/.config/opencode/plugins/` and the shared lib and upgrade guide beside them, installs the seven distributed agents into `~/.config/opencode/agents/`, and writes `~/.config/opencode/package.json` with the `@opencode/plugin` dependency, running `npm install` under `~/.config/opencode/` when that dependency is missing from `node_modules`. opencode 2.x loads the installed plugins from `~/.config/opencode/plugins/` through the documented global discovery layout — direct `.ts`/`.js` files and immediate plugin package directories — and reads the installed agents from `~/.config/opencode/agents/<name>.md`; a `plugins/` directory beside a project-root `opencode.json(c)` sits outside the auto-discovered set. The install is idempotent (`rust.apg.install.write_if_changed`) and prunes apg-owned files outside the plugin set, so an install root carried over from a V1 layout ends at the V2 plugin set.

The install surface keeps its other properties: the duplicate-install warning quietens nothing (a project `.opencode/` file that duplicates an installed suite file still draws the loud warning, and `apg init` deletes nothing — `solution.constraint.duplicate-install-warning-preserved`), the detection concerns the documented V2 locations (a project `.opencode/` file and the installed copies under `~/.config/opencode/`), and the distributed-agent embed/install/prune surface (`solution.component.distributed-agent-install`) is unchanged in membership.

Acceptance criteria: `rust.apg.install`'s embedded-file registry carries the tool plugins and installs them into `~/.config/opencode/plugins/`; it installs the seven distributed agents into `~/.config/opencode/agents/`; `OPENCODE_PACKAGE_JSON` names the `@opencode/plugin` dependency; the `npm install` trigger checks for `@opencode/plugin` under `node_modules`; the stale-prune covers the apg-owned files outside the plugin set; the duplicate-install warning behaviour is unchanged and concerns the documented V2 locations.
